zh.name: 有光
zh.description: 一起读经、祷告、彼此扶持，在祂的光中一同长大。
zh.hi: 在祂的光中，我们看见光
zh.hiSub: 操练自己以至于敬虔。——提摩太前书四章7节
zh.footerLine: 愿你在这里遇见生命的光。

en.name: Light
en.description: Read the Word, pray, and encourage one another as we grow in His light.
en.hi: In Your light we see light
en.footerLine: May you meet the light of life here.
